Shiftry

Grass Dark

Hoenn · Generation 3

Shiftry is a Grass/Dark-type Wicked Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1.3 m tall and weighs 59.6 kg. It evolves from Nuzleaf. Its highest base stat is Attack (100), with a base stat total of 480.
